atoms.sound: I bear a lot of responsibility at my workplace.
atoms.b: I ((bear)) a lot of responsibility at my workplace.

atoms.sound: Last week, a colleague bore the pressure of an important task and finished it successfully.
atoms.b: Last week, a colleague ((bore)) the pressure of an important task and finished it successfully.

atoms.sound: The burden of last month’s deadline had been borne by the whole team.
atoms.b: The burden of last month’s deadline had been ((borne)) by the whole team.

instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to grind</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: To use some herbs and nuts for cooking, you need to grind them.
atoms.b: To use some herbs and nuts for cooking, you need to ((grind)) them.

atoms.sound: For yesterday’s pasta, my aunt ground pine nuts for her pesto.
atoms.b: For yesterday’s pasta my aunt ((ground)) pine nuts for her pesto.

atoms.sound: I have ground many herbs with a mortar and pestle to make fresh tea.
atoms.b: I have ((ground)) many herbs with a mortar and pestle to make fresh tea.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to strike in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to strike</lang>, in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Usually, employees strike for better wages and fair treatment.
atoms.b: Usually, employees ((strike)) for better wages and fair treatment.

atoms.sound: In 2019, the Fridays for Future movement struck a chord with the public by protesting for a safe future.
atoms.b: In 2019, the Fridays for Future movement ((struck)) a chord with the public by protesting for a safe future.

hint.text: to strike a chord – Anklang finden, einen Nerv treffen
hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to strike a chord</lang> bedeutet Anklang finden, einen Nerv treffen.
hint.label: to strike a chord

atoms.sound: Historically, unions have struck bargains with employers and managed to gain legal limits to working hours.
atoms.b: Historically, unions have ((struck)) bargains with employers and managed to gain legal limits to working hours.

hint.text: to strike a bargain – einen Deal aushandeln, eine Vereinbarung treffen, eine Einigung erzielen
hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to strike a bargain</lang> bedeutet einen Deal aushandeln, eine Vereinbarung treffen oder eine Einigung erzielen.

atoms.sound: Jonathan regularly withdraws cash from the ATM.
atoms.b: Jonathan regularly ((withdraws)) cash from the ATM.

atoms.b: In total, he has ((withdrawn)) more than half of his savings this month.
